notes: Owner's decision 2026-10-11 (docs/decisions/2026-10-11-when-stylebro-goes-stable.md): 1.0 ships after two clean trials in a row, first-run trials on new kinds of repository with no high-severity bugs; external users aren't required. Tally: 0 in a row after trial 37 (2026-10-20; owner: "Not clean"): MSBuildSdks' Directory.Build.rsp says /Restore, so bro's own MSBuild queries restored with a forced target framework and left two netstandard2.0 projects a net9.0 restore output (NU1109): `dotnet format` couldn't load them, format and check said "Not verified" and the TreatWarningsAsErrors build failed on 4 findings there (`bro check --build` caught it); BRO1113 removed two MarkdownSnippets regions in shouldly and its build failed ("Missing snippet"), which no bro verdict reported; renames changed code Shouldly quotes in its failure messages (37 of 1,122 tests failed); all fixed (queries pass -restore:false; snippet regions stay and the renamers keep names snapshot files or, with Shouldly, strings of the file quote: owner's choices). Held up: preview, format, check and check --build agreed on every repository (Not verified, exit 3, IDE0049 held back on SDK 10.0.113), the lens-2 spot repro named the projects a failed one kept from compiling, Xunit.Combinatorial (StyleCop 1.2, migrate) changed nothing. Before: 0 in a row after trial 36 (2026-10-20; owner: "Not clean"): `bro format` silently left out NodaTime's lib/commandline/*.cs (compiled by a project from above src/, the solution's folder), `bro check` called the rest clean, and the TreatWarningsAsErrors build failed on 134 StyleBro findings there (`bro check --build` caught it); `bro preview` said "clean after 1 run" and exited 0 where format said "Not verified" (SharpZipLib, NodaTime, WireMock.Net); in a spot repro `bro check --build` said "Clean" when a project a failed one needed never compiled; all fixed (format formats such files, the preview ends like format, --build names uncompiled projects: owner's choices). PR #266's gaps held: IDE0049 held back with exit 3 on SDK 10.0.113, an old-style net48 project named as not loaded; C-Sharp-Algorithms (random) clean. Before: 0 in a row after trial 35 (2026-10-20; owner: "Not clean"): `bro format` stopped at the restore on sqlite-net (a multi-targeted project with a net8.0-ios framework and no iOS workload); the SDK's IDE0049 wrote `using X = nint;` into sqlite-net's SQLite.cs, which a netstandard2.0 library compiles with C# 7.3 (CS8370), and the multi-target guard that should hide such fixes is ignored by SDK 10.0.113's `dotnet format` for IDE rules; BRO1606 left `class.</c>.` in Castle Core's doc comments (32 CS1570); BRO1304 renamed nested interfaces that Castle Core's tests name in strings (`Tests+PrivateInterface`, 6 failures); all fixed (format leaves such projects alone, passes the guard the files an older C# compiles and holds the guard's IDE fixes back where `dotnet format` ignores suppressors: owner's choices). Trial 34's fixes held (#if opening `try {` in ExcelDataReader, BRO1008's skips in Castle Core, an unlisted reference in a MemoryPack spot copy). Before: 0 in a row after trial 34 (2026-10-19; owner: "Not clean"): `bro format` never settled on netmq (a `try {` that `#if DEBUG` opens: the Debug and Release runs re-indented the statement inside it every run) while `bro check` said clean; on protobuf-net format said "Clean" above a BRO1008 warning no fix could change (the TreatWarningsAsErrors build reports it), skipped protobuf-net.Test in its net8.0 run (a referenced project the solution filter doesn't list) and counted a CRLF line-ending artifact as an IDE0055 finding; all fixed (BRO1008 now skips such files, owner's choice). Trial 33's fixes held (lone CRs, xUnit 1.24+, BRO1405 query alignment); the runtime-style run (complog, `init --style microsoft --write`) matched its baseline. Before: 0 in a row after trial 33 (2026-10-19; owner: "Not clean"): `bro format` left taglib-sharp's and Scriban's files with a lone CR out, still said "Clean" (exit 0, `bro check` too), and the TreatWarningsAsErrors build failed on them; with xunit.analyzers 1.24+ (Tmds.DBus) format said Clean where check said Not clean (its fixes have no Fix All from 1.24 on); BRO1405 left a query's clauses misaligned, so Ix.NET needed a second run; all fixed. The runtime-style run (Tmds.DBus, `init --style microsoft --write`) matched its baseline. Before: 0 in a row after trial 32 (2026-10-18; owner: "Not clean"): init's end_of_line = lf converted RazorLight's CRLF test files, whose multi-line verbatim strings then held LF, and two rendering tests failed; format skipped two CAP samples in its net10.0 run (transitive references), needed a second run in Pinta (BRO1132 with K&R braces, BRO1504 with tab_width 8), and migrate re-indented ControlzEx's case blocks; all fixed. Trial 33 must include a dotnet/runtime-style repository run with `bro init --style microsoft` (owner's decision 2026-10-18, "Lens in trial 33"): the Microsoft style (backlog 075, docs/styles.md) has never been trialed on code that follows the runtime's conventions. Before: 0 in a row after trial 31 (2026-10-18; owner: "Not clean"): init marked Hangfire's whole repository as vendored code (a GPL COPYING next to its own LICENSE.md), so StyleBro would have formatted nothing there, and the renames changed 8 Avalonia property registration fields in Ursa.Avalonia (AVP1022); both fixed. Before: 1 clean in a row after trial 30 (2026-10-18; owner: "Count it clean"): Chell, rwmt/Multiplayer, QuestPDF and AvaloniaVisualBasic6 converged in one run with builds and tests as on the untouched code; the one bug (format stopped at the restore on Android/iOS/Browser heads without their workloads) changed nothing and is fixed. Before: 0 after trial 29 (Harmony's patch parameters and listed private fields renamed, Moq's build broke on a file format skipped next to a T4 template).
